title: Integrating the Vercel AI SDK into React 19: Streaming AI Chat, Generative UI, and Tool Calling
seoTitle: Vercel AI SDK & React 19: Streaming Chat &...
description: Learn how to build real-time streaming LLM chat interfaces, generative UI, and tool calling in React 19 with the Vercel AI SDK and Next.js.

author.name: Aafaque Nazir
author.bio: Independent web engineer building high-performance websites, e-commerce stores, and SaaS web applications for clients across India & worldwide.

quickAnswer: The Vercel AI SDK combined with React 19 lets developers build real-time streaming text, dynamic generative UI components, and secure server-side tool calls with minimal boilerplate code.

faqs.question: How do React 19 actions work with the Vercel AI SDK?
faqs.answer: React 19 actions handle form submissions and state updates natively, allowing you to pass user messages directly into the useChat hook without manual event preventDefault plumbing.

faqs.question: What is generative UI in the Vercel AI SDK?
faqs.answer: Generative UI allows the LLM to return rendered React components instead of plain text by using tools that map function calls to client-side UI components.

faqs.question: Can I use the Vercel AI SDK with custom backends?
faqs.answer: Yes, while it integrates cleanly with Next.js API routes and server actions, you can use the AI SDK core package with Express, Fastify, or Node.js HTTP servers.

sections.title: Setting Up the Environment with React 19 and Next.js

sections.text: React 19 introduces major improvements to client-side state management, form actions, and hook handling. When paired with the Vercel AI SDK, setting up a real-time chat interface takes very little code. For example, when building data-heavy tools like our [Inventory Management / InvMaster OS](/projects/1/), adding AI assistants helps operators query godown stock levels using plain natural language.

sections.title: Development Tip
sections.text: Always ensure your API routes handling the LLM streams are marked as edge runtime or nodejs runtime with streaming enabled so chunks reach the client instantly.

Tool calling allows language models to execute specific JavaScript functions on your server to fetch live data. This bridges the gap between static LLM text generation and real-world database lookups.

items: Validate all tool inputs using Zod schemas on the server before running database queries.
Handle connection drops gracefully with built-in retry mechanisms in the AI SDK.
Keep system prompts concise to reduce time-to-first-token latency for users.
